newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - April 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - April 23.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Wednesday:

* Peruvian Army soldiers stormed the residence of the Japanese Ambassador in Lima, freeing all but one of the 72 hostages held there by Marxist guerillas. One hostage and 14 guerillas died in the battle that ended the four-month siege.

* Whitewater prosecutor Kenneth Starr told a Federal Court he needed more time to finish his investigation, which has centred on the Clintons' political and personal affairs, as he had found "extensive evidence" of obstruction of justice.

* News Analysis: Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori faced international pressure to avoid a military raid to free hostages held captive in the Japanese Ambassador's residence in Lima by Marxist guerillas. But his gamble paid off.
* Conservative Republican Senators put forth a list of budget demands, including a hold on domestic spending, tax relief and no adjustment to the Consumer Price Index.
* Saks and Japan's Isetan Co said they made a $290 million offer for upscale clothing retailer Barney's.
